creator.name: Name

creator.startItems: Starting gear: {weapon} and {mantle} in your mantle color.

intro.panel_1: Five thousand years ago, two wizards slew a god.
intro.panel_2: Lucael and Baelor took his power. But they had lost all faith in humanity, and so they turned to darkness.
intro.panel_3: Ever since, as the Lords of Morvath, they have spread their corruption across the land.
intro.lucael: Is this all humanity has left?
intro.baelor: You're not even worth killing, little insect. Come back when you're stronger.
intro.panel_5: Few have faced the Lords of Morvath and lived.
intro.panel_6: You wake in the Monastery of Greyhaven. Your journey begins here.
intro.tapToContinue: Tap or press Space to continue

fight.hint: Attack them! Left mouse = strike, right mouse = heavy hit.
fight.hintTouch: Attack them! Tap Attack or Heavy.
fight.freeze: Time bends to us. Not to you.

pringle.2: Did you really think you could just leave?
pringle.4: I am Sultan. Show me you're ready for the world out there.
pringle.caption1: The city gate at sunset. Pringle sits in the middle of the path.
pringle.caption3: Purple smoke and wind. Pringle grows…
pringle.caption4: A tall cat man stands in the smoke: cat ears, a tail, golden eyes.

brink_tower.caption1: Master Brink's tower. Shelves full of books, candles everywhere, and in the middle a circle on the floor.
brink_tower.1: Ah, a visitor in my tower. Come in, come in. Mind the candles.
brink_tower.caption2: Brink raises his hand. Four crystals light up one by one: water, fire, nature and wind.
brink_tower.2: Normal magic draws on the elements: water, fire, nature and wind. Every mage gets one of them, through a crystal on the staff.
brink_tower.3: It starts slowly, I won't lie. But magic rewards those who are patient. In the end, this is the strongest path.

sam_cellar.caption1: A dark cellar under the Academy. Purple light glows from a circle on the floor.
sam_cellar.1: Hm. Not many visitors find their way down here.
sam_cellar.caption2: Sam steps into the circle. Black and purple smoke curls around his hands.
sam_cellar.2: My magic comes from Lucael and Baelor themselves. I don't serve them. I use their own power against them.
sam_cellar.caption3: The smoke is gone. Sam looks at you.
sam_cellar.3: Dark magic is strong, and quickly. But remember: it is a dark road.

hud.rested: You rest in your bed. HP and mana are full again.
hud.qualityLowered: Graphics lowered to {quality} to keep the game smooth.
hud.qualityChosen: Graphics set to {quality} for this device. You can change it in Settings.
hud.levelUp: Level up! You are now level {level}.
hud.gearInCombat: You can't change gear during a fight.
hud.packInCombat: Not now, you are in a fight.

chosen.sword: Your path: sword fighter. Sir Garrick is your teacher.
chosen.light: Your path: light magic. Master Brink is your teacher.
chosen.dark: Your path: dark magic. Wizard Sam is your teacher.

place.monastery: The Monastery is your checkpoint. If you fall, you wake up here. Rest in your bed to recover.
place.market_square: The Market Square: buy and sell goods. The stalls change all the time.
place.forge: You can trade gold for upgrades or new items.
place.alchemy_lab: In the Alchemy Lab you brew potions and learn new recipes.
place.golden_kettle: The Golden Kettle: everyone comes here for stories, rumors and hints.
place.garden: In the Garden you can grow your own herbs. They keep growing while you are away.
place.academy: The Academy, where mages are trained. Your path will be chosen here.
place.training_field: The training field. Sword fighters sharpen their skills here.
place.harbor: The harbor of Greyhaven. Ships come and go across the bay.
place.city_gate_blocked: You are not ready to leave the city yet.
place.old_tjikko: Old Tjikko, the ancient tree. The elves draw their magic from it.
place.elven_city: The city of the elves, high in the branches. Treewardens are never attacked here.
place.aqueduct: The aqueduct bridge carries the river into the city. Mist hangs above the water.
place.watchtower: The watchtower keeps an eye on the northern coast.
place.greenwood_shrine: A small elven shrine. It is your checkpoint in the Greenwood.
place.wortelgrotten: Roots block the entrance to De Wortelgrotten. Something stirs deep below.
place.mournfen_monastery: A wooden monastery on stilts, high above the wet ground. It is your checkpoint in the Mournfen.

brother_ansel.1: Welcome back. The Monastery's doors are always open to you.
brother_ansel.2: Remember: should you fall, you will wake up here again.
brother_ansel.3: Rest in your bed whenever you are tired. Greyhaven awaits.

marco.1: Welcome, welcome! Everything here is special, just for you.
marco.2: Come back soon. My stock changes every day!

hilda.1: HA! A new face! Bring me gold and materials and I'll make that sword sing.
hilda.2: I can also break old gear down into materials.

fizzwick.1: Oh! Mind the smoke. My eyebrows will grow back, I'm sure of it.
fizzwick.2: Bring me ingredients and I'll teach you a recipe or two.

rose.1: Hello, dear. The Garden is a quiet place. Plants need patience.
rose.2: Fresh herbs dry by themselves after a few days. Dried ones still have their uses.

bertha.1: Come in, come in! Sit by the fire. What can I get you?
bertha.2: They say the Lords of Morvath slew a god, long ago. Brr.
bertha.3: If you're ever stuck, come and ask me. I hear everything.

master_brink.1: Welcome to the Academy. Magic rewards those who are patient.
master_brink.2: Come back when you are ready to choose your path.

offer.1: Ah, the one who faced Sultan. Word travels fast in this tower.
offer.2: I teach the magic of the world itself: Water, Fire, Nature and Wind. Your staff will carry one of them.
offer.3: My path starts slowly. But patience is rewarded: in the end, no magic burns brighter.

master_brink.confirm: Are you sure? Once you say yes, light magic is your path for the rest of the game.

accepted.1: Then welcome, student. Patience, practice, and a little curiosity. That is all I ask.
accepted.2: Your Entrance Exam will be ready soon. Come and see me then.

master_brink.declined: Take your time. Patience, remember? My door stays open.
master_brink.student: Your Entrance Exam is not ready yet. Patience, student.
master_brink.otherPath: You chose another path. I hope you know where it leads.

wizard_sam.1: Hm. Not many visitors find their way to me.
wizard_sam.2: Dark magic is strong, quickly. Remember that it is a dark road.

offer.1: You came all the way down the stairs. Most turn back halfway.
offer.2: What I teach is the magic of Lucael and Baelor. Their own power, turned against them. It is strong from the very first day.
offer.3: But hear me well: it is a dark path. It grows weaker as you grow older, and it does not let go of you easily.

wizard_sam.confirm: Are you sure? Once you say yes, dark magic is your path for the rest of the game.

accepted.1: So be it. Remember: you chose this. Nobody pushed you.
accepted.2: Your Entrance Exam will be ready soon. The cellar will be waiting.

wizard_sam.declined: Wise, perhaps. The cellar will still be here.
wizard_sam.student: Your Entrance Exam is not ready yet. Come back soon.
wizard_sam.otherPath: You chose the light, or the blade. Hm. We shall see who was right.

sir_garrick.1: A sword fighter stands in front and takes the blows for the team.
sir_garrick.2: Train hard, and steel will never let you down.

offer.1: So you are the one who beat Sultan with nothing but an old sword. Not bad at all.
offer.2: A blade never runs out of mana. Steel, sweat and a steady heart: that is all I teach. You stand in front and take the blows, so others can strike.

sir_garrick.confirm: Are you sure? Once you say yes, the sword is your path for the rest of the game.

accepted.1: Ha! Good. Then we start where every blademaster starts: on the training field.
accepted.2: Your Entrance Exam will be ready soon. Get some rest until then.

sir_garrick.declined: No shame in that. The field is here if you change your mind.
sir_garrick.student: Your Entrance Exam is not ready yet. Come back soon, student.
sir_garrick.otherPath: You chose another teacher. A pity; you have a good arm. Train hard anyway.

sultan.1: You fought well, little one. Pringle was only a disguise. Cats have their secrets.
sultan.2: Go on, the world is waiting. But when you are stronger, come back. I want a rematch.
sultan.3: Nine lives, remember? I still have eight.

gold.desc: Shiny coins. Used to buy, sell and upgrade.

travel_mantle.desc: A simple travel mantle with golden embroidery.

mage_staff.desc: A neutral staff. It only works with a crystal.

wizard_crystal.desc: A crystal with a random element: Water, Fire, Nature or Wind.

slime_gel.desc: Sticky gel left behind by a slime.

honed_old_sword.desc: Your old sword, honed by Hilda. Every hit does 3 more damage.

goblin_cleaver.desc: A crude, heavy goblin blade. Hits hard, but you feel every kilo.

chiefs_greatblade.desc: The Goblin Chief's pride. Enormous damage, enormous weight.

straw_hat.desc: Keeps the sun out of your eyes. Light as a feather.

leather_cap.desc: Simple boiled leather. Better than nothing.

iron_helm.desc: Solid iron. Strong protection, but heavy on your head.

padded_mantle.desc: A thick, quilted mantle that softens blows.

ironweave_mantle.desc: Woven with iron threads. Very strong, very heavy.

copper_amulet.desc: A simple charm that hums faintly with magic.

goblin_tooth_necklace.desc: Goblin teeth on a string. Somehow it makes you fiercer.

swift_ring.desc: Your steps feel a little lighter.

chiefs_signet.desc: The Goblin Chief's ring. Heavy with stolen gold.

heartwood_ring.desc: Carved from a fallen branch of Old Tjikko. It feels alive.

herb_seeds.desc: Seeds from Rose. You can plant them in your plot later.

defeat_sultan.desc: Leave the city: defeat Sultan at the city gate.

your_resolve.objective: Choose a teacher: Sir Garrick, Master Brink or Wizard Sam
your_resolve.desc: Go to the Academy and choose your path. Sir Garrick waits on the training field, Master Brink in his tower and Wizard Sam in the cellar.

offer.1: Spring brings blossom. Could you bring me five?

progress.1: Five Blossom, dear. Only in spring.

first_harvest.desc: Bring Rose 5 Blossom from the Garden.

a_quiet_awakening.desc: Brother Ansel found you by the road. Rest in your bed at the Monastery.
a_quiet_awakening.objective: Rest in your bed at the Monastery

offer.1: Ah, you're awake. Easy now. I found you unconscious by the road, far from any town, and carried you here.
offer.2: This is the Monastery of Greyhaven. It is your checkpoint now: should you ever fall, you will wake up here again.
offer.3: Your bed is right over there. Lie down and rest a while; it heals body and mind. Come and see me when you feel better.

progress.1: Go on, rest in your bed first. Walk up to it and press E (or tap Rest).

complete.1: There, colour in your cheeks again. Whenever you are hurt, a bed at a checkpoint makes you whole.
complete.2: Take these coins for the road. Marco on the Market Square sells potions. Greyhaven is yours to explore.

just_for_you.desc: Buy 2 Health Potions from Marco on the Market Square.

offer.1: A new customer! And what a fine one. Today, and only for you, my Health Potions are a steal.
offer.2: Buy two, just to be safe. A wise traveller never leaves town without them. Trust me!

progress.1: Still thinking it over? Two Health Potions, special price, just for you.

complete.1: Pleasure doing business! Drink one with Q, or tap the potion button, whenever you are hurt.
complete.2: Here, a little something back. Don't tell the other merchants.

steel_and_slime.desc: Bring Hilda 3 Slime Gel from the slimes in the yard by the north-east city wall. She will hone your old sword.

offer.1: HA! That rusty old thing is your sword? It couldn't cut butter on a summer day!
offer.2: I can hone it for you. But I need Slime Gel to polish the steel. Three blobs of it.
offer.3: A few slimes have crept into the old yard by the north-east city wall. Whack them and bring me their gel!

progress.1: No gel, no shine! The slimes are in the old yard by the north-east city wall.

complete.1: Ooh, nice and sticky. Hand me that sword. *CLANG* *CLANG* *hiss*
complete.2: There! Your Honed Old Sword. Every hit bites a little harder now. Come back when you have gold and materials!

a_patch_of_earth.desc: Rose has a small plot for you in the Garden. Go and see it.
a_patch_of_earth.objective: Go to your plot in the Garden

offer.1: Hello, dear. Every traveller needs a place where something grows. Even a wanderer like you.
offer.2: There is a little plot at the south end of the Garden, by the hedge. It's yours now. Go and have a look.

progress.1: Your plot is at the south end of the Garden, by the hedge. Go and stand on it.

complete.1: Lovely soil, isn't it? Here are some seeds to start with.
complete.2: We'll plant them together another day; plants need patience. Your plot keeps growing even while you are away.

tales_by_the_fire.desc: Listen to Old Bertha's tale about the Lords of Morvath.

offer.1: Come in, come in, sit by the fire! You're the one Brother Ansel found by the road, aren't you? I hear everything.
offer.2: Let me tell you a tale. Five thousand years ago, two wizards, the brothers Lucael and Baelor, did the unthinkable: they slew a god.
offer.3: They took its power and became demi-gods. They do not grow old, they do not fall ill. Folk call them the Lords of Morvath.
offer.4: Now they are necromancers. They raise slimes, goblins, skeletons and worse all over Eryndor, and their corruption spreads from the east.
offer.5: The further east you go, the darker it gets. But you... you have a stubborn look about you. Perhaps that's good.

progress.1: Sit, sit. Let an old woman tell her tale.

complete.1: Brr. Even I get the shivers telling it. Have some soup, it's on the house.
complete.2: And if you are ever stuck, come and ask Old Bertha. Somebody always knows something.

a_friend_for_the_road.desc: Marco has something for you after your fight with Sultan.

offer.1: You beat Sultan! The whole market is talking about it. A cat in disguise, who'd have thought.
offer.2: Listen, someone who fights like that will soon carry more than two arms can hold. This is Biscuit, my donkey. He's yours.
offer.3: He's stubborn, he's slow to complain and he carries a heavy load without a word. Whatever is on his back doesn't weigh on you.

complete.1: Go on, say hello. Talk to him and you can load your spare gear onto him or take it off again.
complete.2: Only remember: what Biscuit carries, you can't use. Take it out of his pack first. And not in the middle of a fight!

season.autumn_extra: Ghosts and Scarecrows roam the land.
season.winter_extra: The Frozen Lake can be reached.

bag.noQuests: No quests right now. Talk to the people of Greyhaven.

load.heavyMessage: Heavy load: you walk slower, dash short and need a moment to get up.

load.lightMessage: Light load: you move freely again.

death.title: You were defeated
death.goldLost: You lost {amount} {gold}. You wake up at your checkpoint.
death.wakeUp: You wake up at your checkpoint.

sultan.retry: Back again? Try to keep up!
sultan.enrage: Not bad… Now I'm getting serious!
sultan.win: Heh… you've got claws after all. You're ready for the world out there.

hint.claw: His claws light up: step back or dash away!
hint.pounce: He crouches, eyes glowing: dash sideways!
hint.charge: A red line: get off it before he runs!
hint.flurry: Flurry! Get away, then strike while he catches his breath.
hint.strikeTouch: He stands still: tap Attack now!
hint.guard: He dodges everything. Wait until he stands still after an attack.

pack.title: {name}'s pack
pack.note: What {name} carries does not count for your load, but you can't use it until you take it out.
